## Dataset-wide leakage / timestamp audit

| issue | extent | rule for our pipeline |
|---|---|---|
| customer_information has several dated snapshots | 2,263 customers with >1 row | join as-of prediction time (latest timestamp ≤ t) |
| first profile snapshot is later than first transaction | 11.6% of customers | for early t these users have no legal profile → treat as missing |
| lastQuestionnaireDate > snapshot timestamp | 38.5% of rows | questionnaire date is not point-in-time; use only if ≤ t, else drop |
| lastQuestionnaireDate = 2000-01-01 placeholder | 7,275 rows | treat as missing |
| riskLevel predicted by the bank | 22.4% of rows | keep a predicted/observed flag; prediction date unknown |
| investmentCapacity predicted by the bank | 23.0% of rows | same |
| limit_prices.profitability / priceMaxDate / maxDate | whole-period values | never use as features (future) |
| close_prices after t | daily series to 2022-11-29 | features only from prices ≤ t |
| asset_information.timestamp | 2018-01-01 … 2022-10-31 | low risk (static metadata), but asset 'exists' only from its first price date |
| reconstructed buys (negative transactionID) | 38,019 rows, 35,620 dated 2018-01-02 | synthetic initial holdings, not real purchase events: keep in history, never as test labels |
| same transactionID on two customers (joint accounts) | 52,308 rows | a purchase may be counted for 2 users |
| transaction totalValue / units / channel | known at transaction time | label-time fields of the target event: not inputs |
